First inauguration of President Ferdinand Marcos held at the Quirino Grandstand, Manila, December 30, 1965 (Public Domain)
1986: Following a massive political protest in the Philippines, President Ferdinand Marcos and his entourage flew into exile.  On 25 February, the 31 ARRS used five H-3 Jolly Green Giant helicopters to evacuate President Marcos and 51 other people from the Presidential Palace in Manila to Clark AB.  A C-9 Nightingale then flew Marcos and his family to Guam.  On 26 February, two C-141s and a C-9 carried Marcos and his entire entourage to Hickam AFB.

data.text:
Fire Hits Residential Area in Intramuros

MANILA, Philippines — A fire broke out in a residential area in Intramuros, Manila on Wednesday afternoon, Feb. 25, 2026. The blaze was reported around 5 p.m. in Barangay 655 near Cabildo and Anda Streets and quickly escalated.

Firefighters from the Manila DRRMO and the Bureau of Fire Protection responded and raised alarm levels to contain the flames. No injuries have been reported so far, and the cause of the fire is under investigation.

Video courtesy: Reginald Antiojo │via Arriane Mae Bobadilla/MS Intern
